one_macro_authoring_brief.name: Continuous tapered anterior throat-to-keel wedge, authored as one sparse 3D cage before plating
one_macro_authoring_brief.why_different: Replace disconnected course-based anterior surface placement with a longitudinally continuous loft. No leaf arrays, sheet masks, one-side cassette, finish, wear or new pose.
one_macro_authoring_brief.authoring: Create ONE symmetric anterior half-loft from upper throat below preserved jaw to existing lower breast/keel. Use6 to8 editable curved cross-sections joined by longitudinal cubic Bezier rails: center anterior keel rail, left/right armor-to-machinery boundary rails, and inset posterior return rails. Cross sections are shallow horseshoes with open side mechanisms, not ellipses wrapped around torso. Refine the neck-base inflection in world3D and inspect projected cage through the ACTUAL camera04 matrices. The cage is a diagnostic smooth surface; no broad exposed new final backing or sculpted hardware.

one_macro_authoring_brief.comparison: First use fixed camera04 ortho35deg/16deg and same metal05 lighting/material settings for before/candidate whole clay+metal. Also show front, true side/profile and unchanged grazing light. Use existing64deg/22deg camera as sensitivity diagnostic, identical for before/candidate; do not declare either recovered source camera.
one_macro_authoring_brief.pass: Whole bird visibly loses horizontal collar and separate upper chest balloon while remaining avian. Source-facing throat-to-breast contour is a smoother oblique wedge, corridor stays readable. Same gain persists in profile/front/grazing without new hooks, abrupt shelves, bowl surfaces, cut holes, machinery burial or support exposure. Cage-only improvement must be visible before any plates. A closeup-only change or gain only at one fitted angle fails.
one_macro_authoring_brief.fail: Reject if smooth macro still reads as same round collar, requires pose/camera edits, larger breast, armor/machine deletion, closed mechanism corridor, dark lighting, or plates to hide poor transitions. Restore149 original visibility states; change approach after this test, not another detail iteration.
one_macro_authoring_brief.test_budget: One cage hypothesis, one matched render set. No generated plate pass before independent full-character review. Parent owns scheduling and any later authoring approval.
